title: Task Schema v0.1
description: Semantic representation of one programming task. One semantic record drives the reference program, the natural-language specification, and the hidden tests.

spec_version.description: Python capability spec version, e.g. python_capability_v0_1

semantics.description: The semantic intent. This is the ground truth the reference code, NL spec, and hidden tests are generated FROM.

operation.description: The abstract operation, e.g. add, mul, max, sum_list, first_element, cond_max

args.description: Argument descriptors, e.g. [{name: a, type: int, role: operand}, {name: b, type: int, role: operand}]

input_types.description: Types of the function inputs, e.g. [int, int] or [list]

constants.description: Explicit constants baked into the task, if any

structure.description: Optional treespec of the reference program AST shape (for metadata + compositional splits)

complexity.description: Rough complexity class, e.g. number of operations

capability_tags.description: Which capability-ladder capabilities this task exercises, e.g. [arithmetic, variables]

reference_code.description: The ground-truth reference Python program (pure function)

template_family.description: Which paraphrase family this wording came from

prompt.description: Full prompt sent to the model

constant_set.description: Which constant distribution this task drew from

identifier_set.description: Which identifier-set this task drew from (e.g. letters vs verbose words)
